note: Structural inventory of kask crates and their lib roots. A full public-API surface enumeration (pub fn/struct/enum/trait/const/type counts per crate, with coverage by tests) requires an API-extraction tool that is not yet wired. The totals below are therefore 0 — they are placeholders until that tool runs. The `crates` map is populated with the lib root path and description for each crate so a future pass has the entry points.

hkask-bridge-dublincore.description: Ontology vocabulary bridge — Dublin Core + BIBO + CiTO + PKO constants and mapping helpers

hkask-capability.description: OCAP delegation token system with Ed25519-signed cryptographic attenuation

hkask-condenser.description: Context condensation domain logic — compression algorithms, classification, profile management, and inference formatting

hkask-email.description: Curator email (MXroute SMTP API outbound + IMAP inbound + algedonic alert email sink)

hkask-forecast.description: Shared superforecasting computation engine — Fermi decomposition, outside/inside view, Bayesian updating, Brier scoring

hkask-goal.description: hKask goal types — minimal coordination substrate for multi-agent collaboration (extracted from hkask-services-core)

hkask-guard.description: hKask content safety guard — mandatory input/output scanning for all LLM boundaries, OWASP LLM Top 10 aligned

hkask-inference.description: Multi-provider inference router for hKask — DeepInfra, Together AI, fal.ai, OpenRouter, KiloCode

hkask-keystore.description: OS keychain integration and AES-256-GCM encryption for hKask

hkask-ledger.description: Double-entry accounting ledger — immutable transactions for cost, crypto, and securities tracking

hkask-mcp-server.description: MCP server utilities, daemon transport, and startup verification for hKask MCP servers

hkask-mcp.description: MCP runtime and governance for hKask

hkask-memory.description: Semantic and episodic memory pipelines for hKask

hkask-services-core.description: hKask service-layer foundation — ServiceError, ServiceConfig, HkaskSettings

hkask-templates.description: Registry, vocabulary, and template execution for hKask

hkask-types.description: ID types, nu-event, and visibility types for hKask

kask_bridge.description: The bidirectional seam between hKask port traits and zed-kask facilities (D8)
